metadata.title: The Beacon App — Weighted Daily Teacher Motivation Pool
metadata.usage: Select 365 quotes in a normal year or 366 in a leap year using deterministic weighted random selection.
metadata.copyright: All quotes in this file were generated as original copy for The Beacon App and have no external author attribution.

rules: Use the calendar year as the base seed.
For each period, select themes according to the configured weights.
Shuffle each theme pool using a seed derived from the year, period ID and theme.
Never use the same quote ID twice within the same calendar year.
Do not alter today's quote when the page refreshes.
At the start of a new year, the seed changes and a different subset and order are produced.
If a selected theme has no unused quotes remaining, draw from another theme in the same period using the remaining weights.
Only allow a repeat after all 630 quotes have been exhausted, which cannot occur within a single year.
On 29 February, select one additional unused quote from Renewal, Reflection, Growth or Purpose using the same deterministic method.
